description: The honest default for long-horizon health trends: weight on actual measurement instants, sleep summed by wake date, resting HR split at source and physical-watch boundaries, and VO2max kept inside vendor estimators that never stitch. Source is always visible; the device label defaults to stable device era and can be switched to the raw source/device name. Missing rows stay missing, self-reported and derived values stay labelled, and no query touches excluded or nested-stage data.

list.name: device_label
list.label: Device label
list.description: Device era is stable across renames. Raw source/device name shows the archive's own label and may split or join renamed devices.
list.query: Device era : era,Raw source/device name : raw

title: Health Trends

panels.title: Weight — measured shape over time
panels.description: One point per stored observation at its real measurement instant. There is no daily fill and no Power Sync data in the store. The self-reported suffix is data provenance, not a heuristic. Lines disconnect across gaps longer than 180 days, while the stable device-era label prevents the 2015 no-device island from being stitched to Aria 2.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT
  start_utc AS time,
  value_num::double precision AS value,
  concat_ws(
    ' · ',
    source,
    CASE ${device_label:sqlstring}
      WHEN 'era' THEN COALESCE(device, 'No device stated')
      WHEN 'raw' THEN COALESCE(NULLIF(raw_source_name, ''), 'No raw source/device name')
    END,
    CASE WHEN value_provenance = 'self_reported' THEN 'self-reported' END
  ) AS metric
FROM health.v_observation
WHERE record_type_code = 'body_mass'
  AND $__timeFilter(start_utc)
ORDER BY 1

WITH bounds AS (
  SELECT
    floor(min(value_num) / 10.0) * 10.0 AS lower_bound,
    ceil(max(value_num) / 10.0) * 10.0 AS upper_bound
  FROM health.v_observation
  WHERE record_type_code = 'body_mass'
    AND $__timeFilter(start_utc)
)
SELECT $__timeFrom()::timestamptz AS time, lower_bound::double precision AS value, '__weight_axis_bounds__' AS metric
FROM bounds
UNION ALL
SELECT $__timeTo()::timestamptz AS time, upper_bound::double precision AS value, '__weight_axis_bounds__' AS metric
FROM bounds
ORDER BY 1

panels.title: Sleep — total asleep time by wake date
panels.description: Session minutes are summed within wake date, source, route and device. Naps therefore add to their day; nested stages are not queried. Source remains visible in every label, so the concurrent Apple and Samsung period stays as two series. A gap of one missing day is disconnected, including the real 27-day April 2019 gap and the empty 2017–2018 interval.

targets.rawSql:
WITH labelled AS (
  SELECT
    local_date::timestamp AS time,
    source_code,
    route,
    device_era,
    value_provenance,
    value_num,
    concat_ws(
      ' · ',
      source,
      CASE ${device_label:sqlstring}
        WHEN 'era' THEN COALESCE(device, 'No device stated')
        WHEN 'raw' THEN COALESCE(NULLIF(raw_source_name, ''), 'No raw source/device name')
      END,
      CASE WHEN value_provenance <> 'measured' THEN replace(value_provenance::text, '_', '-') END
    ) AS metric
  FROM health.v_observation
  WHERE record_type_code = 'sleep_session'
    AND local_date BETWEEN $__timeFrom()::date AND $__timeTo()::date
)
SELECT
  time,
  (sum(value_num) / 60.0)::double precision AS value,
  metric
FROM labelled
GROUP BY time, metric, source_code, route, device_era, value_provenance
ORDER BY 1, 3

panels.title: Resting HR — labelled device eras
panels.description: One vendor-computed observation at its route-native display instant: Apple intervals at their stored end, point routes at their start, and never a locally re-derived estimate. Source and device era remain separate series: the 2015–2016 Fitbit island cannot join the post-2018 era, the 2017–2018 absence stays empty, and Apple's three physical watches remain three default series. Gaps longer than 36 hours disconnect the line, including Samsung's missing dates.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT
  COALESCE(end_utc, start_utc) AS time,
  value_num::double precision AS value,
  concat_ws(
    ' · ',
    source,
    CASE ${device_label:sqlstring}
      WHEN 'era' THEN COALESCE(device, 'No device stated')
      WHEN 'raw' THEN COALESCE(NULLIF(raw_source_name, ''), 'No raw source/device name')
    END,
    CASE WHEN value_provenance <> 'measured' THEN replace(value_provenance::text, '_', '-') END
  ) AS metric
FROM health.v_observation
WHERE record_type_code = 'resting_heart_rate'
  AND local_date BETWEEN $__timeFrom()::date AND $__timeTo()::date
ORDER BY 1, 3

panels.title: VO2max — vendor estimates, never stitched
panels.description: Every stored Apple sample and Samsung workout estimate appears at its emitted instant. Vendors remain separate series with no preferred or merged path, because estimator levels are not interchangeable. Lines disconnect after 45 days without an estimate. Hidden selected-window context points round the observed range outward to 5 mL/kg/min, keeping tenths small without flattening real multi-point movement or publishing a personal bound.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT
  start_utc AS time,
  value_num::double precision AS value,
  concat_ws(
    ' · ',
    source,
    CASE ${device_label:sqlstring}
      WHEN 'era' THEN COALESCE(device, 'No device stated')
      WHEN 'raw' THEN COALESCE(NULLIF(raw_source_name, ''), 'No raw source/device name')
    END,
    CASE WHEN value_provenance <> 'measured' THEN replace(value_provenance::text, '_', '-') END
  ) AS metric
FROM health.v_observation
WHERE record_type_code = 'vo2max'
  AND $__timeFilter(start_utc)
ORDER BY 1, 3

WITH bounds AS (
  SELECT
    floor(min(value_num) / 5.0) * 5.0 AS lower_bound,
    ceil(max(value_num) / 5.0) * 5.0 AS upper_bound
  FROM health.v_observation
  WHERE record_type_code = 'vo2max'
    AND $__timeFilter(start_utc)
)
SELECT $__timeFrom()::timestamptz AS time, lower_bound::double precision AS value, '__vo2max_axis_bounds__' AS metric
FROM bounds
UNION ALL
SELECT $__timeTo()::timestamptz AS time, upper_bound::double precision AS value, '__vo2max_axis_bounds__' AS metric
FROM bounds
ORDER BY 1

panels.title: Body fat — device-bounded BIA estimates
panels.description: Exact published body-fat percentages at their real observation instants. Aria 2 and Galaxy Watch7 remain separate derived BIA series; five unattributed Apple Health entries remain self-reported context. No interpolation, cross-device precedence, calibration or clinical target band is applied. Lines disconnect after 180 days, and hidden selected-window context points round the observed range outward to 5% without committing personal bounds.

SELECT
  start_utc AS time,

  AND $__timeFilter(start_utc)
ORDER BY 1, 3

WITH bounds AS (

    floor(min(value_num) / 5.0) * 5.0 AS lower_bound,
